summary: 828 trials started in the 12 weeks from 2026-07-13 to 2026-10-04 and 109 paid within 7 days of the trial ending: 13.2%. Trials that got a first client booking inside the trial paid 27.7% of the time, against 3.6% for the rest (7.7x), and only 39.7% got there. Activation is the lever: 10 more points of activation is about 19.9 more paying accounts per 12 weeks. Paid social brings 21.6% of trials but activates only 17.9% of them. Against published bands the rate is GREAT (ChartMogul 2026, no-card) and between GOOD and GREAT (Lenny's Newsletter 2023). Keep the 14-day, no-card setup; add an activation nudge, a branch on activation, a post-expiry email and setup calls for teams of 6 or more. Target: 15.6%.

activation_split.definition: first booking made by a client through the account's booking page, on or before the trial end date
activation_split.reading: Activated trials pay 7.7x as often (27.7% vs 3.6%) and 83.5% of paying accounts had a client booking first, so the activation definition holds.

findings: Paid social: 21.6% of trials, 17.9% activate, 11.0% of paying accounts. Fix the first run for these signups before buying more.
Organic search: 16.7% of its trials pay (45.3% activate), the best rate per trial of any source.

comparisons.source: ChartMogul, The SaaS Conversion Report (Kyle Poyar), survey January 2026, 200 software products
comparisons.range: no-card trials: GOOD 4-6%, GREAT 10-15% (card-required: GOOD 25-35%, GREAT 50-60%)

comparisons.source: Lenny's Newsletter, What is a good free-to-paid conversion rate (Kyle Poyar and Lenny Rachitsky), August 2023, 1,000+ products
comparisons.range: free trials: GOOD 8-12%, GREAT 15-25%, counted as paying within 6 months of signup

benchmark.caveat: The two sources disagree and count differently. This rate stops at trial end + 7 days, so it reads lower than a 6-month count. Judge progress on your own weekly rate, not on a band.

checks.check: Activation nudge in days 0 to 2, sent only to trials that haven't activated
checks.evidence: Day 0 'Welcome to your trial' goes to all trials and its aim is a welcome, not the first client booking.

checks.check: At least one touch branched on activation
checks.evidence: All 3 touches go to all trials, so a trial that already took bookings gets the same day 3 tips as one that never set up.

checks.check: Ending notice in the last 3 days of the trial
checks.evidence: Day 13 'Your trial ends tomorrow' is in place.

checks.check: A touch in the 7 days after the trial ends, to trials that didn't pay
checks.evidence: Nothing is sent after day 14, yet the account locks and waits for a plan.

checks.check: A human touch for trials that meet the sales rule

proposed.touch: Setup checklist with 3 steps, the last one 'get your first client booking'
Publish your booking page and send the link to 3 regular clients (T1)
Customer success offers a 20-minute setup call (T2)
Keep the day 3 tips email, sent only to trials that have a booking
Second nudge: import your client list and turn on reminders
Keep 'Your trial ends tomorrow'; for activated trials, show their bookings so far
Your bookings page is paused: pick a plan to turn it back on
Last note: your settings are saved for 30 days

touch_calendar.write_with: Email Sequence Builder (if installed) writes these emails; nothing is sent by this skill.

type.current: no card, locks at the end, no free plan
type.why: A card rule changes who starts a trial, so trial-to-paid alone can't judge it. Switch only after a split test on paying accounts per 1,000 signup-page visitors, and only once activation is fixed. A reverse trial needs a free plan to fall back to, which this product doesn't have.

sales_rule.rule: Trials with 6 or more staff (the Business plan size) get a setup call offer on day 2
sales_rule.why: They already pay more often (21.3% vs 12.4%) and fit the Business plan at 99 a month, the highest price, so a call is worth the most here.

target.how: Activation up 10 points (39.7% to 49.7%), with each group paying at today's rate (27.7% and 3.6%).
target.judge_on: trials that start in the 12 weeks after the changes ship

tests.change: Day 0 in-app checklist and a day 1 email to trials with no client booking yet: publish the booking page and send the link to 3 regular clients
Customer success offers a 20-minute setup call on day 2 to trials with 6 or more staff
tests.verdict: too slow to A/B test at this volume: ship to every trial it targets, compare the 8 weeks after with the 8 weeks before, and label it weaker evidence

tests.change: Paid social signups land on a setup screen that imports their service list before the calendar
tests.verdict: too slow to A/B test at this volume: ship to every trial it targets, compare the 8 weeks after with the 8 weeks before, and label it weaker evidence

ship_without_a_test: Post-expiry emails on days 16 and 19: there is no touch today to test against, and they only reach trials that didn't pay.
Send the day 3 tips email only to activated trials: it narrows a touch that exists to the trials it fits.
not_checked: Signup-page visitors were not in the input, so a card-required trial can't be sized here.
Klaviyo reports per message; the send day of each message came from the team.
